title: On Evaluating Quantum Kernel Robustness for Low-Resource Cross-Corpus Audio Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.00649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic speech detection is critical for audio security, but performance can degrade when labeled data are scarce and evaluation conditions differ from training. This study examines quantum kernel methods and lightweight neural models for cross-corpus audio deepfake detection under limited training data. We compare a Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM), a classical support vector machine (SVM), and a multilayer perceptron (MLP), all trained on frozen wav2vec 2.0 embeddings using a strict budget of 200 training samples. To match the qubit budget of near-term quantum hardware, embeddings are reduced to four dimensions using principal component analysis, and all models use the same reduced features. translated_title: 《关于评估量子核方法在低资源跨语料库音频深度伪造检测中的鲁棒性》
translated_abstract: 合成语音检测对音频安全至关重要，但在标注数据稀缺且评估条件与训练条件不一致时，检测性能可能显著下降。本研究在训练数据受限的条件下，考察了量子核方法与轻量级神经模型在跨语料库音频深度伪造检测中的表现。我们比较了量子支持向量机（QSVM）、经典支持向量机（SVM）和多层感知机（MLP），三者均基于冻结的 wav2vec 2.0 嵌入进行训练，且严格限制训练样本为 200 个。为匹配近期量子硬件的量子比特预算，采用主成分分析将嵌入降至四个维度，所有模型均使用相同的降维特征。在 ASVspoof 2019、ASVspoof 5、ADD 2023 挑战赛以及 In-the-Wild 数据集上的实验表明，在从 ASVspoof 2019 到 ADD 2023 的严重域偏移下，MLP 的性能退化至接近随机水平，其曲线下面积（AUC）为……（原文摘要至此处不完整）
tldr: 本研究在仅 200 个训练样本和四维 wav2vec 2.0 降维特征的极低资源条件下，系统评估了量子支持向量机（QSVM）与经典 SVM、MLP 在四个数据集上跨语料库音频深度伪造检测的鲁棒性，发现在严重域偏移下 MLP 性能退化至接近随机水平。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates the robustness of quantum kernel methods versus classical SVM and MLP models for cross-corpus audio deepfake detection under an extreme low-resource budget of 200 training samples and four-dimensional wav2vec 2.0 features, finding that the MLP degrades to near-random performance under severe domain shift.
